t2.title: Cooking at home healthier than eating out
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is cooking at home healthier than eating out?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
With busy lifestyles, many people rely on restaurants and takeaway food. However, I firmly believe home cooking is healthier.

Firstly, cooking at home gives complete control over ingredients. You can choose fresh vegetables, limit salt and sugar, and avoid unhealthy additives. Restaurant meals often contain hidden fats and excessive sodium.

Secondly, portion control is easier at home. Restaurants serve large portions to provide value, encouraging overeating. At home, you can prepare appropriate amounts, helping maintain a healthy weight.

However, eating out has benefits. It saves time, offers variety, and provides social experiences. Additionally, some restaurants focus on healthy menus with nutritional information.

Nevertheless, research consistently shows people who cook at home have better nutritional intake. They consume more fruits and vegetables and fewer calories overall.

In conclusion, while occasional dining out is enjoyable, regular home cooking should be prioritized for better health. Even simple meals prepared at home are typically more nutritious than restaurant food.

Dear FreshBox Team,

I wanted to give you some feedback about my experience with your meal kits. Overall, I'm pretty happy with the service. The recipes are usually easy to follow, and the ingredients seem fresh. However, sometimes the portions are a little too small, especially the vegetables. I think there could be more vegetables in the boxes.

Also, I would like to see more vegetarian options. I don't eat meat very often, so it would be great to have more meals without meat. For example, maybe some Indian or Thai dishes. Thank you for asking for my opinion!

t2.sampleB2:
Home-Cooked or Eating Out — Which Wins for Your Health?

These days, with restaurants on every corner and delivery apps at our fingertips, eating out has never been easier. But when it comes to our health, I'm convinced the home kitchen comes out on top.

The main reason is control. When you cook for yourself, you decide exactly what goes onto your plate: fresh vegetables instead of hidden fats, and just a pinch of salt rather than a heavy hand of it. Restaurants, by contrast, tend to pile on oil and sugar to make their dishes irresistible.

Portion size is another factor. Large servings often leave us stuffed, whereas at home we can dish up sensible amounts and steer clear of piling on the pounds.

Of course, there's nothing wrong with a meal out now and then. It saves time and brings people together. Still, it ought to be a treat rather than a daily routine.

All things considered, home cooking wins hands down. It's cheaper, more nutritious, and it puts you in charge of your own wellbeing. In short, a home-cooked meal is one of the simplest investments you can make in your health.
t2.uzSample:
Band bo‘lgan turmush tarzi bilan ko‘pchilik restoranlar va olib ketishga tayyor ovqatlarga tayanadi. Biroq, men uyda ovqat tayyorlash sog‘lomroq ekanligiga qat’iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, uyda ovqat tayyorlash ingredientlar ustidan to‘liq nazoratni ta’minlaydi. Siz yangi sabzavotlarni tanlashingiz, tuz va shakarni cheklashingiz va zararli qo‘shimchalardan qochishingiz mumkin. Restoran ovqatlarida ko‘pincha yashirin yog‘lar va haddan tashqari natriy mavjud.

Ikkinchidan, uyda porsiyalarni nazorat qilish osonroq. Restoranlar qiymatni ta’minlash uchun katta porsiyalarni taqdim etadi va bu ortiqcha ovqatlanishga undaydi. Uyda siz mos miqdorni tayyorlashingiz mumkin, bu esa sog‘lom vaznni saqlashga yordam beradi.

Biroq, tashqarida ovqatlanishning afzalliklari bor. Bu vaqtni tejaydi, xilma-xillikni taklif qiladi va ijtimoiy tajribalarni ta’minlaydi. Bundan tashqari, ba’zi restoranlar ozuqaviy ma’lumotlarga ega sog‘lom menyularga e’tibor berishadi.

Shunga qaramay, tadqiqotlar doimiy ravishda uyda ovqat tayyorlaydigan odamlar yaxshiroq ozuqaviy iste’molga ega ekanligini ko‘rsatadi. Ular ko‘proq meva va sabzavotlar iste’mol qilishadi va umuman kamroq kaloriya olishadi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, vaqti-vaqti bilan tashqarida ovqatlanish yoqimli bo‘lsa-da, yaxshiroq sog‘liq uchun muntazam ravishda uyda ovqat tayyorlashga ustunlik berish kerak. Uyda tayyorlangan oddiy ovqatlar ham odatda restoran ovqatlariga qaraganda ko‘proq to‘yimli bo‘ladi.

Shuningdek, men vegetarianlikdan tashqari, yanada aniqroq parhez variantlari (masalan, glyutensiz, sut mahsulotisiz) kengroq auditoriya tomonidan mamnuniyat bilan qabul qilinishiga ishonaman.

Hurmat bilan,

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the meal kit service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear FreshBox Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your meal kit service. I am thoroughly impressed with the quality. The fresh ingredients always arrive in perfect condition. The recipe cards are clear and easy to follow, even for a beginner. I've genuinely improved my cooking skills. However, I have some suggestions. Some recipes require rather long preparation times, which isn't ideal for weeknight dinners. Additionally, the plastic packaging seems excessive. I would appreciate more quick meals under 30 minutes. Vegetarian options and low-carb meals would cater to different dietary needs. Also, using sustainable packaging would reduce environmental impact. Overall, FreshBox has made home cooking enjoyable and convenient. Yours sincerely, Sabina Rahimova

Dear FreshBox Team,


Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you about my experience with your meal kits. I think the food is very good, and the recipes are easy to understand. The ingredients are usually fresh, but sometimes the vegetables are a little old.


I also think you should have more vegetarian options. My wife doesn't eat meat, so it's difficult to find meals we both like. Also, the packaging is a lot of plastic, and I am worried about the environment.


Overall, I am happy with FreshBox. Thank you.


Sincerely,


Sabina Rahimova
t12.sampleB2:
Dear FreshBox Team,

Thank you for reaching out to ask how I've found your meal kit service. On the whole, I've been very pleased with it.

The ingredients turn up fresh every week, and the recipe cards are so clear that even a nervous cook like me can follow them without any trouble. Thanks to FreshBox, I've picked up a handful of new skills in the kitchen.

That said, there is room for improvement. To begin with, a few of the recipes take far too long to prepare after a long day at work, so I'd welcome more quick meals under thirty minutes. Secondly, the plastic packaging strikes me as excessive, and switching to sustainable packaging would go a long way towards cutting waste.

Thank you for taking my comments on board.

Yours sincerely,
Sabina Rahimova
